lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple horizontal rows posterior to the branchial slits, forming a non-uniform geometric grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by linear highlights and accompanying shadow gradients beneath.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small-diameter, high-luminance blobs on the pre-branchial cephalic region.
